tagline.en: App-first eSIM with free trial tier and post-quota low-speed keep-alive
tagline.zh: App制eSIM：有免费体验流量，超额降速不断网

description.en: Yoho Mobile (YOHO MOBILE PTE. LTD., Singapore) sells app-installed eSIMs across 200+ countries with no QR flow. Plans list underlying operators (Japan: Rakuten/KDDI/CMCC); example price Japan 10GB/7d from $7.45. A free eSIM trial is offered in-app. "Yoho Care" keeps low-speed connectivity after quota; 100% refund policy advertised.
description.zh: Yoho Mobile（新加坡 YOHO MOBILE PTE. LTD.）卖 App 一键安装的 eSIM（无二维码流程），覆盖 200+ 国。套餐会标底层运营商（日本：Rakuten/KDDI/CMCC），样例价：日本 10GB/7天 7.45 美元起。App 内有免费 eSIM 体验。超额后「Yoho Care」保持低速不断网；官方宣传 100% 退款。

details.en:
Yoho Mobile is app-first: plans are bought and installed in the app (one tap, no QR), with a web configurator showing per-plan operators (Japan example: Rakuten Mobile / KDDI / CMCC variants at $7.45–8.72 for 10GB/7d). Coverage 200+ countries; "Yoho Care" preserves low-speed data after quota exhaustion, and a 100% refund policy is advertised.

Free tier: the official site promotes a free eSIM trial, claimable only in the mobile app (yohomobile.com/freeesim redirects to store listings). The old watch-an-ad-for-HK-data mechanism appears only in third-party write-ups — treat as deprecated or app-only, unverified.

Community single-user hands-on (2026-09, unverified): the ad-supported free HK data once offered a Hong Kong local IP on China Mobile throttled around 100KB/s; that user saw no throttling while others did — inconsistent reports. Value-for-money now rated mid-tier.
details.zh:
Yoho Mobile 主打 App 制：套餐在 App 内购买并一键安装（无二维码），网页配置器会显示各套餐底层运营商（日本例：Rakuten/KDDI/CMCC，10GB/7天 7.45–8.72 美元）。覆盖 200+ 国；「Yoho Care」在流量耗尽后保持低速连接；官方宣传 100% 退款。

免费额度：官网推广免费 eSIM 体验，仅能在手机 App 领取（yohomobile.com/freeesim 跳转应用商店）。老的「看广告换香港免费流量」机制只出现在第三方文章——按已废弃或 App 专属处理，未核实。

社区单用户实测（2026-09，未核实）：当年看广告的免费香港流量给香港本地 IP、走中国移动、限速约 100KB/s；该用户自称没被限速但他人有限速报告——口径不一。当前性价比评价中等。

bestFor.zh: 习惯App操作、想先免费试再用、在意底层运营商透明的用户。

note.en: USCardForum field report: Yoho eSIM in mainland China rides China Mobile and presents a native Hong Kong IP; a Chinese review video claims 'high-purity HK residential broadband IP'. Residential claim is community-sourced and unverified.
note.zh: 美卡论坛实测：Yoho eSIM 在中国大陆走中国移动、出口为香港本地 IP；中文评测视频称其为'香港高纯度家庭宽带 IP'。住宅性质为社区口径，未经独立核实。
